title: Bhutan
subtitle: Phuntsholing · Thimphu · Paro

travel.train: Fly to Bagdogra — drive to Phuntsholing

itinerary.title: Bagdogra to Phuntsholing
itinerary.description: Meet at Bagdogra Airport by 11:00 AM. Drive approximately 5 hours to Phuntsholing (gateway to Bhutan). Immigration process completed en route. Photo stop at Zangto Pelri monastery. Dinner and hotel stay in Phuntsholing.

itinerary.title: Phuntsholing to Thimphu
itinerary.description: Breakfast and check out. Drive approximately 5 hours to Thimphu. En route visit Kharbandi Gompa. In Thimphu visit BBS Clock Tower, Tashichho Dzong. Free time for shopping at local market. Dinner and overnight stay in Thimphu.

itinerary.title: Thimphu Full-Day City Tour
itinerary.description: Breakfast. Full-day sightseeing in Thimphu. Visit Royal Takin Preserve, Buddha Dordenma Statue, Standing Buddha Park, National Library, Handicraft Centre, and Simply Bhutan. Return to hotel. Dinner and overnight stay in Thimphu.

itinerary.title: Thimphu to Paro
itinerary.description: Breakfast and check out. Drive approximately 2 hours to Paro. Visit traditional Bhutanese beer brewery, National Museum (Ta Dzong), and Paro Dzong. Evening: traditional Bhutanese cultural program (at own expense). Dinner and overnight stay in Paro.

itinerary.title: Tiger's Nest Trek
itinerary.description: Breakfast. Visit Taktsang Monastery (Tiger's Nest) — perched on a cliff at approximately 3,120 metres. The trek is approximately 12 km total from Paro town. After return, visit Drukgyel Dzong Viewpoint. Free time for shopping at local market. Dinner and overnight stay in Paro.

itinerary.title: Paro to Bagdogra
itinerary.description: Breakfast and check out. Begin the approximately 9-hour road journey back to Bagdogra. Check in at hotel, have dinner. Overnight stay in Bagdogra.

itinerary.title: Bagdogra to Home
itinerary.description: Breakfast and check out. Drop at Bagdogra Airport by approximately 9:00 AM. Catch your flight to your respective city.

advisory: Original Voter ID or Passport (valid 6+ months) mandatory. Aadhaar NOT accepted. PVC cards downloaded online NOT accepted. Carry warm clothing for high altitude.
flightNote: Fly to Bagdogra (IXB). Meet at airport by 11:00 AM. Return flight from Bagdogra on 02 Oct 2026. Flights to be booked independently.
